summary: After a release tag lands on main, fast-forward existing release track branches to the tag without force push (#1434; design #1433).
migration_impact: Release finalization and release.yml now move standing release branches via non-force fast-forward. Admin force-with-lease reset requires gh plate release finalize --force-hard-reset --apply.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate_core and sync release.yml from upstream.

2. If branch rulesets block direct pushes to standing release branches, add your lifecycle GitHub App (secrets PLATE_APP_ID + PLATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY) as a ruleset bypass actor with Always allow, or grant github-actions bypass on org repos where policy allows.
3. Re-run gh plate release finalize <ver> --apply to repair a missed fast-forward; use --force-hard-reset --apply only for explicit admin recovery.
agent_notes: Automatic path never force-pushes release branches. Stop-on-first-block when a branch diverged from the tag; inspect blocked.unshipped_commits in the helper result.
